title: Owntend Dependency Security and License Exception Registry
description: Authoritative registry for time-bounded, owner-approved dependency security and license exceptions. Every exception requires explicit business/technical rationale, named owner sign-off, maximum severity ceiling, and hard expiration date. Indefinite or unowned exceptions fail closed.

exceptions.reason: Canonical dbus 0.7.13 is an LGPL-3.0-or-later transitive Linux desktop platform dependency required by flutter_secure_storage_linux and app_links_linux. It is scoped to Linux desktop support and is not compiled, linked, or bundled into Android production APK or AAB artifacts.
